ei.title: Practice 01 — 생각 없이 규범에 순응하는 경향
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: Ellen Langer and her colleagues studied the conditions under which people engage in mindless conformity. To forty secretaries at a New York university, they sent a memo that said, "This paper is to be returned immediately to Room 238 through interoffice mail." Like almost all other memos at this university, this one was unsigned. Note that this is a pretty silly request; if the person who sent the memo wanted it, why did he or she send it in the first place? Langer and her colleagues hypothesized that secretaries would go ahead and return the memo without much thinking, because they would follow the norm that says, "Do what memos tell you to do." They were right; 90 percent of the secretaries dutifully returned the memo to Room 238.

questions.passage: Ellen Langer and her colleagues ①<u>studied</u> the conditions under which people ②<u>engaging</u> in mindless conformity. To forty secretaries at a New York university, they sent a memo that said, "This paper is to be ③<u>returned</u> immediately to Room 238 through interoffice mail." Like almost all other memos at this university, this one was ④<u>unsigned</u>. Note that this is a pretty silly request; if the person who sent the memo wanted it, why did he or she send it in the first place? Langer and her colleagues hypothesized that secretaries would go ahead and return the memo without much thinking, because they would follow the norm that says, "Do what memos tell you to do." They were right; 90 percent of the secretaries dutifully returned the memo to Room 238.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① studied=연구했다, ② engaging→engage 오류(전치사 in 뒤 동명사는 정상이나 여기선 관계부사절 내 동사 원형 필요), ③ returned=반환된, ④ unsigned=서명 없는
det.analysis:
❌ ① studied: 'studied the conditions' — 과거동사 정상
✅ ② engaging: 'under which people engage in mindless conformity' — 관계절(관계부사 which 선행)의 동사는 engage(원형). engaging(현재분사)는 동사 역할 불가하여 어법 오류
❌ ③ returned: 'to be returned immediately' — be+p.p. 수동태 정상
❌ ④ unsigned: 'this one was unsigned' — be+과거분사 형용사 정상
det.tip: 관계부사절 'under which S + V' 구조에서 V는 동사 원형(시제 일치). 현재분사(-ing)는 동사 역할 불가

questions.passage: Ellen Langer and her colleagues studied the conditions under which people engage in mindless conformity. To forty secretaries at a New York university, they sent a memo that said, "This paper is to be returned immediately to Room 238 through interoffice mail." Like almost all other memos at this university, this one was unsigned. Note that this is a pretty silly request; if the person who sent the memo wanted it, why did he or she send it in the first place? Langer and her colleagues ①<u>hypothesized</u> that secretaries ②<u>would go ahead</u> and return the memo ③<u>without much thinking</u>, because they would follow the norm that says, "Do what memos tell you to do." They were right; 90 percent of the secretaries ④<u>dutiful</u> returned the memo to Room 238.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① hypothesized=가설을 세웠다, ② would go ahead=계속 진행했다, ③ without much thinking=별 생각 없이, ④ dutiful→dutifully 오류(부사가 필요)
det.analysis:
❌ ① hypothesized: 과거동사 정상
❌ ② would go ahead: 조동사 would + 동사원형 go ahead 정상
❌ ③ without much thinking: '전치사 without + 동명사 thinking' 정상
✅ ④ dutiful: 'dutifully returned the memo' — returned는 동사이므로 수식어는 부사(dutifully)가 맞음. dutiful(형용사)은 명사 수식에만 쓰이므로 오류
det.tip: 동사 수식 = 부사(-ly). 형용사는 명사만 수식. 'dutiful' → 'dutifully'로 써야 returned(동사) 수식 가능

questions.passage: Ellen Langer and her colleagues studied the conditions under which people engage in mindless conformity. To forty secretaries at a New York university, they ③<u>sent</u> a memo ①<u>what said</u>, "This paper is ②<u>to be returned</u> immediately to Room 238 through interoffice mail." Like almost all other memos at this university, this one was unsigned. Note that this is a pretty silly request; if the person who sent the memo wanted it, why did he or she send it in the first place? Langer and her colleagues hypothesized that secretaries would go ahead and return the memo without much thinking, because they ④<u>would follow</u> the norm that says, "Do what memos tell you to do." They were right; 90 percent of the secretaries dutifully returned the memo to Room 238.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① what said→that said 오류(관계대명사 자리에 선행사 memo가 있으므로 that이 맞음. what은 선행사 없이 쓰임), ② to be returned=수동 to부정사 정상, ③ sent=과거동사 정상, ④ would follow=조동사+원형 정상
det.analysis:
✅ ① what said: 'a memo that said' — that은 선행사(memo)를 받는 관계대명사로 정상. 이 자리를 'what said'로 바꾸면 what은 선행사 없이 쓰이는 관계대명사인데 앞에 선행사 memo가 있으므로 오류
❌ ② to be returned: 'is to be returned immediately' — 수동태 to부정사 정상
❌ ③ sent: 'they sent a memo' — 과거동사 정상
❌ ④ would follow: 'they would follow the norm' — 조동사 would + 원형 정상
det.tip: 관계대명사 that/which/who = 선행사 있음. what = 선행사 없음(~하는 것). 선행사 있으면 that/which 사용

questions.passage: Ellen Langer and her colleagues studied the conditions under which people engage in ①<u>mindless</u> conformity. To forty secretaries at a New York university, they sent a memo that said, "This paper is to be returned immediately to Room 238 through interoffice mail." Like almost all other memos at this university, this one was unsigned. Note that this is a pretty ②<u>silly</u> request; if the person who sent the memo wanted it, why did he or she send it in the first place? Langer and her colleagues ③<u>denied</u> that secretaries would go ahead and return the memo without much thinking, because they would follow the norm that says, "Do what memos tell you to do." They were right; 90 percent of the secretaries ④<u>dutifully</u> returned the memo to Room 238.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① mindless=생각 없는(맥락 적절), ② silly=어리석은(맥락 적절), ③ denied→hypothesized 맞음(가설을 세웠다. denied는 부정했다는 의미로 부적절), ④ dutifully=충실히(맥락 적절)
det.analysis:
❌ ① mindless: 'mindless conformity — 생각 없는 순응' 문맥 적절
❌ ② silly: 'a pretty silly request — 꽤 어리석은 요청' 문맥 적절
✅ ③ denied: 'Langer and her colleagues denied that secretaries would...' — 실험 가설을 부정했다는 의미. 원문 hypothesized(가설을 세웠다)가 맞음. denied는 반대 의미
❌ ④ dutifully: '90 percent dutifully returned — 충실히 반환' 문맥 적절
det.tip: hypothesize = 가설을 세우다. deny = 부정하다/거부하다. 실험 전 예측을 설명하는 문맥이므로 hypothesize가 적절

questions.passage: Ellen Langer and her colleagues studied the ①<u>conditions</u> under which people engage in mindless conformity. To forty secretaries at a New York university, they sent a memo that said, "This paper is to be returned immediately to Room 238 through interoffice mail." Like almost all other memos at this university, this one was ②<u>verified</u>. Note that this is a pretty silly request; if the person who sent the memo wanted it, why did he or she send it in the first place? Langer and her colleagues hypothesized that secretaries would go ahead and return the memo without much thinking, because they would follow the ③<u>norm</u> that says, "Do what memos tell you to do." They were ④<u>right</u>; 90 percent of the secretaries dutifully returned the memo to Room 238.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① conditions=조건(맥락 적절), ② verified→unsigned 맞음(서명 없는이 맞음. verified=검증된은 부적절), ③ norm=규범(맥락 적절), ④ right=옳은/맞은(맥락 적절)
det.analysis:
❌ ① conditions: 'studied the conditions under which...' — 연구 맥락에 적절
✅ ② verified: 원문 'this one was unsigned(이 메모는 서명이 없었다)'. verified(검증된/확인된)으로 바꾸면 실험 설계 맥락에서 완전히 다른 의미
❌ ③ norm: 'follow the norm that says' — 사회 규범 맥락 적절
❌ ④ right: 'They were right' — '예측이 맞았다' 문맥 적절
det.tip: unsigned = 서명이 없는. verified = 검증된/확인된. 메모가 서명 없이 왔음에도 비서들이 따랐다는 실험 맥락에서 unsigned가 필수적

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 규범을 따르는 것 ② 사내 우편 ③ 많은 생각 ④ 생각 없는 순응
det.analysis:

❌ ③ much thinking: 많은 생각 = mindless(생각없는)의 반대 개념
✅ ④ mindless conformity: 본문 첫 문장에서 직접 정의된 연구 대상. without much thinking + follow the norm + 90% returned가 모두 지지
det.tip: mindless = 생각 없는. conformity = 순응/따름. 실험의 핵심 개념이므로 지문 첫 문장에 정의됨
